hooks.name: Self-Challenge Before Writing Docs
hooks.description: Run manually before writing requirement/design documents to verify completeness. Previously auto-fired on every docs/ write which violated T1.

action.prompt:
If the file being written is NOT under the docs/ folder, skip this check entirely and proceed without comment.

STOP. Before writing this file, answer these questions internally:

1. Have you extracted every VERB from the source document and confirmed each maps to an AC with equal or greater strength? (e.g., "arbitrates" needs a resolution action, not just a display)
2. Have you extracted every specific NOUN and confirmed it appears explicitly — not under a generic umbrella? (e.g., "room proximity" and "gap minimization" must be named, not hidden under "soft constraints")
3. Have you checked every QUALIFIER and confirmed distinctions are preserved? (e.g., "consecutive" vs "daily", "fortnightly" vs "weekly")
4. List 3 specific things you might have missed or generalized. If you cannot identify any, you are likely not looking hard enough — re-read the source.
5. Are all gaps RESOLVED (added to a story or explicitly deferred with user confirmation)? Unresolved gaps mean this file is not ready to write.

If you find issues, fix them BEFORE writing. Do not write a file with known gaps.
